topic: Traditional savings (gold, chits, FDs, LIC) and where mutual funds can fit, explained neutrally
judge_note: Three short beats (keep the gold, keep the chit, add one habit) feel reassuring and communal, and nothing is attacked.

slides.headline: Keep the gold. Keep the chit. Add one habit.
slides.subhead: Mutual funds don't replace your savings. They sit beside them.

slides.title: Mutual funds alongside your other savings

points.title: Gold is still gold
points.text: Jewellery, heirlooms, Deepavali purchases. Nothing here says stop. Gold keeps its place.

points.title: FDs, chits, insurance stay
points.text: They serve goals you already know. A mutual fund is one more tool in the box.

points.title: Each tool, one job
points.text: Gold for tradition, FDs for stability, SIPs for long-term goals. Each has a purpose.

slides.headline: Send to someone who says 'I have gold'.
slides.cta: Not replacing anything. Just adding one more way to save.
slides.footnote: Mutual funds are subject to market risks. Read all scheme related documents carefully.

caption:
